sources.title: MathForm: Scaling Mathematical Autoformalization with Knowledge ...
sources.snippet: MathForm-8B, trained on FormalVerse (a new dataset of 367K verified Lean 4 examples), achieves 72.37% Pass@8 on mathematical autoformalization and outperforms specialized 32B models — showing that retrieval-guided training and verification-driven refinement can close the scale gap in formal mathematics.
